narration: One-off spending and recurring spending get treated as the same kind of thing.
caption: एक बार का खर्च और हर महीने का खर्च एक ही तराज़ू पर तोल दिए जाते हैं।
image_brief: Two shopping bills pinned side by side on a kitchen corkboard, one very long and one short, evening lamp light.

narration: A single large purchase dents the deposit once. It leaves the target alone.
caption: एक बड़ी ख़रीद बचत को एक बार चोट देती है। लक्ष्य को छूती नहीं।
image_brief: A new steel almirah standing against a bedroom wall with its packing foam still lying on the floor, daylight from a window.

narration: A small monthly commitment raises the target forever. Three hundred times, every month.
caption: हर महीने का छोटा खर्च लक्ष्य हमेशा के लिए बढ़ा देता है। तीन सौ गुना।
image_brief: A small monthly payment slip lying on a table beside a very tall column of stacked coins, warm light from one side.

narration: Back to the two people from the start. Incomes far apart, one shared fraction.
caption: शुरू के उन दो लोगों पर लौटें। कमाई अलग-अलग, अनुपात एक जैसा।
image_brief: The two identical brass jars back on the stone windowsill, now filled with coins to the same height, late afternoon light.

narration: The high earner funds a larger life. Larger life, larger pot required.
caption: ज़्यादा कमाने वाला बड़ी ज़िंदगी चलाता है। बड़ी ज़िंदगी, बड़ा फंड।
image_brief: A long dining table set for eight in a spacious room with every chair pulled out, evening light through tall windows.

narration: The modest earner funds a smaller one, and needs less of it.
caption: कम कमाने वाला छोटी ज़िंदगी चलाता है, और उसे कम की ज़रूरत है।
image_brief: A small floor mat laid for two with two steel plates and one shared bowl, warm light from a single bulb.

narration: Both are running at the same ratio. So both arrive in the same span.
caption: दोनों एक ही अनुपात पर चल रहे हैं। इसलिए दोनों एक ही समय में पहुँचते हैं।
image_brief: Two bicycle tyre tracks running side by side along a dirt road, both the same length, early morning light.

narration: Salary decides how comfortable the journey is. The gap decides how long it lasts.
caption: सैलरी तय करती है सफ़र कितना आरामदेह है। अंतर तय करता है वह कितना लंबा है।
image_brief: A long railway platform with a cushioned bench and a plain wooden bench facing the same track, both empty, grey morning light.

narration: That is the reframe. Earning more is not the same as getting closer.
caption: यही नया नज़रिया है। ज़्यादा कमाना और मंज़िल के पास पहुँचना एक बात नहीं।
image_brief: A stone milestone half buried in grass at the edge of a highway, its far face turned away, harsh noon sun.

narration: A raise is neutral by itself. What happens next sets its direction.
caption: सैलरी बढ़ना अपने आप में तटस्थ है। दिशा अगला क़दम तय करता है।
image_brief: A coin standing balanced upright on its edge on a bare wooden table, nothing else in frame, even daylight.

narration: Spent completely, it resets the clock. Partly unspent, it pulls the finish line closer.
caption: पूरा खर्च हो गया तो घड़ी रीसेट। कुछ बच गया तो मंज़िल पास आ जाती है।
image_brief: A wind-up alarm clock on a bedside table with its winding key turned back to the start, dim early light.

narration: Chasing returns gets the attention. The gap is the part actually under control.
caption: रिटर्न के पीछे भागना सबका ध्यान खींचता है। अपने बस में तो अंतर है।
image_brief: A blank market ticker board of empty rows on a wall above a deserted counter, cool indoor light.

narration: One fraction, two effects, and a target that only spending gets to set.
caption: एक अनुपात, दो असर, और लक्ष्य सिर्फ़ खर्च तय करता है।
image_brief: A single tap above a brimming steel drum with one drop hanging from the spout, soft window light.

narration: The one calculation: last month's take-home, minus what left the account, divided by take-home.
caption: एक हिसाब: पिछले महीने की कमाई, घटाओ जो निकला, भाग दो कमाई से।
image_brief: A bank statement page on a table with a pen resting on its final line and a plain calculator beside it, bright daylight.

narration: Then one monthly subscription, times three hundred. That number is the pot behind it.
caption: फिर किसी एक मासिक ख़र्चे को तीन सौ से गुणा करें। वही उसका असली दाम है।
image_brief: A folded paper payment mandate on a desk under a glass paperweight with a tall stack of coins behind it, evening light.
